IG credit extended a 15-week inflow streak (+$9.5bn inside a ~$20bn total-bond week), while gold added a token +$0.5bn (though gold's +$75bn YTD is a record and it is the top-performing asset YTD, ~+27.7%) and crypto saw a small -$0.1bn outflow, consistent with its deeper Fear reading. On the BofA private-client tape US equities logged their first net inflow in five weeks (+$4.1bn, hedge-fund-led) with record Consumer-Discretionary inflows and the biggest Financials outflows. The positioning picture stays stretched/greedy even as CNN Fear&Greed reads 41 (Fear) — flows lag price and sit into the 28-29 Jul FOMC. Europe/China/Japan were not separately itemized in retrievable free sources this week.
